ITA-9.5.86 kavalaḥ कवलः
Mouth gargle
A therapeutic procedure in which medicated decoctions, oils or other suitable liquids are retained under constant movement in the oral cavity for a specific time.

ITA-5.76.167 kavala-atiyogaḥ कवल-अतियोगः
Condition due to excessive use of gargling therapy
A condition characterized by loss of taste; stomatitis; thirst.

ITA-5.76.165 kavalacikitsāpacāraḥ कवलचिकित्सापचारः
Condition due to improper gargling therapy

ITA-5.76.166 kavalahīnayogaḥ कवलहीनयोगः
Condition due to suboptimal use of gargling therapy
A condition characterized by dullness/frigidity/inactivity; nausea with mucus; ageusia.
